suenan dos golpes en la puerta: and there are two knocks at the door
Marina y Julián se miran nerviosos: Marina and Julián look at each other nervously
su mamá llegó de visita: their mother has come to visit
el perrito sigue escondido en el cuarto: and the puppy is still hidden in the room
Tú le abres y yo: You open the door and I
yo no sé ni qué decir: I do not even know what to say
Su mamá entra con una sonrisa: Their mother comes in with a smile
una bolsa de pan caliente: and a bag of warm bread
Parece que rompieron un plato: You look as if you broke a plate
tenemos que contarte algo: we have something to tell you
y por favor escúchanos hasta el final: and please hear us out to the end
En ese momento el perrito sale del cuart: Just then the puppy comes out of the room
mueve la cola y se acerca a ella: wags his tail and goes up to her
Ustedes saben que el edificio no los per: You know the building does not allow them
pero estaba bajo la lluvia: but he was out in the rain
no fui capaz de dejarlo ahí: and I could not leave him there
Un perro no es un juguete: A dog is not a toy
Ya lo hablamos y nos repartimos cada tar: We have talked it over and shared out every task
Y mañana preguntamos casa por casa: And tomorrow we ask house by house
por si alguien lo está buscando: in case somebody is looking for him
El administrador no va a decir: The building manager will not say
Entonces lo convencemos entre todos: Then we will all talk him round
La mamá los mira un largo rato: Their mother looks at them for a long while
Ve al perro ya dormido: She sees the dog already asleep
Hablo yo con el administrador: I will speak to the manager
pero ustedes cumplen su parte: but you two keep your side of it
Lo vamos a cuidar como a nadie: We will look after him like nobody else
pero desde hoy todos trabajamos por ti: but from today we all work for you
Pero a la primera queja del vecino: But at the neighbour's first complaint
